policy_name: Northwind Ltd Employee Expense Policy v4.2

rules.title: No alcohol
rules.text: Alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstances, including when it appears as part of a meal bill or a client dinner.
rules.breach: The claim covers alcoholic drinks, a bar tab, wine, beer, spirits, or a bill the description shows includes drinks.
rules.clean: The claim covers food, soft drinks, coffee, or anything with no alcohol in it.

rules.title: Economy class on short flights
rules.text: Flights with a scheduled duration under six hours must be booked in economy class. Premium economy, business and first class are reimbursable only on long-haul flights over six hours.
rules.breach: A premium cabin was booked on a route that is a short-haul or domestic hop.
rules.clean: Economy class, or a premium cabin on a genuine long-haul intercontinental route.

rules.title: Hotels via the corporate portal
rules.text: Accommodation must be booked through the corporate travel portal. Direct bookings with hotels or consumer booking sites are not reimbursable without a written exception.
rules.breach: Accommodation booked directly with a hotel, or through a consumer travel or short-let marketplace.
rules.clean: Accommodation booked through the corporate travel portal or the company travel desk, or a claim that is not accommodation at all.

rules.title: Client entertainment needs attribution
rules.text: Client entertainment is reimbursable only when the claim records which client was hosted and the business purpose of the meeting.
rules.breach: Hospitality that hosted external guests but the description names no client and gives no business purpose.
rules.clean: The description names the client hosted and why, or the claim does not involve entertaining anyone external.

rules.title: No gifts to officials
rules.text: Gifts, hospitality or anything of value provided to a government official, regulator, or employee of a state-owned body is prohibited regardless of value.
rules.breach: The recipient described is a public official, regulator, civil servant, or someone at a state-owned organisation.
rules.clean: No gift was given, or the recipient is a private-sector counterparty or a colleague.

rules.title: No personal items
rules.text: Personal purchases are not reimbursable even when incurred during business travel.
rules.breach: Clothing, toiletries, entertainment, family costs, or anything the employee would have bought for themselves anyway.
rules.clean: A cost that exists only because of the business trip or the business task.

rules.title: No fines or penalties
rules.text: Fines, penalty charges, parking tickets, congestion charge penalties and late fees are never reimbursable.
rules.breach: The claim is a fine, penalty, ticket, or late-payment charge.
rules.clean: An ordinary charge for a service, including legitimate parking or congestion charges that are not penalties.

rules.title: Meal cap
rules.text: Meals are reimbursable up to 45.00 per person per day.

rules.title: Pre-approval above 250
rules.text: Any single expense above 250.00 requires a documented pre-approval reference.

rules.title: Receipts above 25
rules.text: Claims above 25.00 must have a receipt attached.
